Manifest.Name: 物品详情美化 · Better Item Tooltips
Manifest.Author: Amres
Manifest.Description: 把物品详情换成一张估价单：售价放大在顶部，其他信息分组、两列对齐。所有数据仍来自原版和其他模组，本模组只负责排版。 / The item tooltip as an appraisal slip: the price large at the top, everything else grouped in two aligned columns. All data still comes from the game and other mods; this mod only lays it out.
